subject: Re: Re: Re: Lost luggage PNR XK92LM
body: This is now my third email and I have received nothing except an automated acknowledgement. My bag went missing on SkyBridge flight SB 207 from Mumbai to Frankfurt on 3 October and the baggage desk at Frankfurt told me to file a report online. I filed it. The reference number is FRA-88213. On 9 October a call centre agent named Dieter promised a call back within 48 hours, and nobody has called. On 16 October I wrote again and was ignored. My bag held medication for my mother and my work laptop, so this is not a small inconvenience. If I do not hear from a real person by Friday I will post the whole sequence on social media and contact the aviation regulator. Anil Deshpande

subject: Hygiene in the canteen at Riverdale Public School
body: Dear Principal, I am writing about the school canteen, where my daughter in Class 6 found a hair in her lunch twice this month, on 7 October and again on 19 October. On the second day she also saw a cockroach near the serving counter and refused to eat anything for the rest of the day. I raised this with the canteen supervisor, who said the children exaggerate and walked off. The washing area behind the counter was visibly dirty when I visited on the 20th, with stagnant water and uncovered bins. Several other parents in the class WhatsApp group are reporting stomach upsets this week. I understand the canteen is outsourced, but the responsibility for keeping children safe remains with the school. I request an immediate inspection and a written response. If there is no action I will approach the education officer and the district food safety office. Yours sincerely, Rajeshwari Narayanan (parent of Anika, 6-C)
